Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE small original chaos-magic sigil, a cutout ink mark for the margins of ReEnchanted books. True transparent background, no paper, no solid fill rectangle, no photograph, no shadow, no border, no labels, no captions. A solitary glyph, not a sheet. The reference images show the existing ink quality and Wicker's brisk, sharp handwritten trace; do not copy their lettering or star shapes. Use near-black plum-brown quill ink with organic dry-brush breaks and tiny ink accumulations where the pen hesitated; restrained fine crosshatching only at one or two stroke overlaps. The line is confident, spiky, slightly impatient, hand-drawn by Wicker Eddies, a clever and dangerous Academy student who questions theatrical certainty and carries a key for the wrong door. His line has intention, not random occult decoration. Spare's and Hine's real monogram method informs these original glyphs: remove spaces and repeated letters, overlap/rotate/simplify the remaining Latin letterforms into a single unfamiliar coherent mark. Keep vowels. The statement of intent is for construction only: never write it out in the image. Shared strokes may represent several letters; the finished glyph must not read as a word or an ordinary capital. Flat usable ink on actual alpha, generously separated strokes that survive reduction to 45-90 pt, consistent 5-12px principal line weight at 1024 resolution, several finer pen strokes. Most of canvas empty transparent around one central glyph. No pentagram, runic alphabet, astrological signs, skull, faces, eye, stock eight-arrow chaos star, elaborate magical diagram, neon, glow, shiny metal, vector-perfect symmetry, or generic fantasy logo. Personality lies in the pen's decisions.
TITLE FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY: The Small Living Thing.
CONSTRUCTION INTENT: I NOTICE THE SMALL LIVING THING.
DEDUPLICATED LETTERS: INOTCEHSMALVG.
DISTINCTIVE FORM: Tiny springing monogram, a leaning N/V pair shares one stem and a tightly curled S/G loop, two unequal L-like shoots step sideways; preserve a small unfilled gap in the middle. Very restrained, like a living inflection, not a botanical picture or little creature.
LORE: The Curse, or Grey/Rut of Routine, flattens colour and attention; it is forgetting and autopilot, not a horned monster. These are original protective and noticing marks drawn by Wicker, not imported medieval seals. Ink strokes only, no cloud or halo. True transparent background. No readable text.

images.title: Awake Inside the Day
images.intent: I AM AWAKE INSIDE THIS DAY
images.design: An upright, freshly split glyph: interlocked A/W zigzags cross a single I/T staff, a narrow D curve opens sideways instead of closing; three unequal short rays derive from the E strokes, no sun icon or eye. A clear little space around the central knot, like an aperture that has just opened.
